description: Use when scanning crypto funding rates for crowded longs/shorts, squeeze risk or funding-arbitrage candidates. Crypto funding rates scanner ($0.0025/call, USDC on Base via x402). Returns the 10 most extreme Hyperliquid perpetual funding rates right now (annualized %, with open interest in USD; perps with >$1M 24h volume) plus funding APR for the watchlist (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, NEAR, AAVE). For trading agents checking crowded positioning before a trade. No params. Example: GET https://cryptofeed402.site/funding/extreme
name: get_extreme_funding

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired (what this MCP tool returns, isError=true)

most_extreme.description: [{symbol, funding_apr_pct, open_interest_usd}] top 10 by absolute funding

title: Extreme funding (paid, x402) — $0.0025

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
